A '''drag course''' used for [[Podracing/Legends|Podracing]] existed on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. The course was simple, weaving out of an arena and into a series of turns in the desert, with few hazards minus some sharper turns near the final stretch of the race. The [[Veknoid/Legends|Veknoid]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Teemto Pagalies/Legends|Teemto Pagalies]] was favored here, and would challenge other racers to one-on-one matches.<ref name="EiR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The course first appeared, unnamed, in the [[1999]] [[Wikipedia:Nintendo Game Boy|Gameboy Color]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Episode I Racer|Star Wars Episode I: Racer]]''. It's one of five courses available at the start of the game.<ref name="EiR" />
